ragdoll.name: Ragdoll Cat
ragdoll.bio: A cloud with paws. Goes limp the moment you pick them up, and purrs like a tiny engine.
ragdoll.hint: Ragdolls love long naps and slow brushing.

corgi.name: Corgi
corgi.bio: Short legs, enormous heart. Will follow you from room to room forever.
corgi.hint: Corgis need lots of play or they get restless.

lop_bunny.name: Holland Lop
lop_bunny.bio: Soft ears that flop like ribbons. Thumps twice when happy.
lop_bunny.hint: Bunnies calm down fastest with quiet grooming.

hamster.name: Peach Hamster
hamster.bio: Found stuffing an entire dinner into both cheeks behind the bakery.
hamster.hint: Offer food first — trust follows the snack.

pomeranian.name: Cloud Pomeranian
pomeranian.bio: A walking pompom who believes they are a very large wolf.
pomeranian.hint: Play, then brush. Poms adore being admired.

cockatiel.name: Lemon Cockatiel
cockatiel.bio: Whistles the same four notes until you whistle them back.
cockatiel.hint: Birds warm up through play and gentle talking.

hedgehog.name: Mochi Hedgehog
hedgehog.bio: Curls into a perfect ball at the first sound, then peeks out one eye.

duckling.name: Butter Duckling
duckling.bio: Decided you were family approximately three seconds after meeting you.
duckling.hint: Ducklings just need company and clean water.

fawn.name: Dapple Fawn
fawn.bio: Waited by the meadow fence for three days before letting you close.
fawn.hint: Never rush a fawn. Soothe, then feed.

red_panda.name: Ember Red Panda
red_panda.bio: Sleeps draped over a branch like a warm scarf someone forgot.
red_panda.hint: Let them nap first, then play.

fennec.name: Dune Fennec
fennec.bio: Enormous ears hear you opening a snack from two rooms away.
fennec.hint: Fennecs trust whoever plays the best games.

shiba.name: Sesame Shiba
shiba.bio: Pretends not to need you, then sits precisely on your feet.
shiba.hint: Shibas warm up slowly. Consistency wins.

penguin_chick.name: Pebble Penguin
penguin_chick.bio: Brings you a small smooth pebble every single morning.
penguin_chick.hint: Keep them cool, keep them fed, keep them close.

sea_otter.name: Kelp Otter
sea_otter.bio: Holds your hand while sleeping so you do not drift away.
sea_otter.hint: Otters need play and very clean water.

snow_fox.name: Frost Fox
snow_fox.bio: Appears only in the quietest snowfall, and only for someone patient.
snow_fox.hint: The rarest friend asks for the most patience.
